results.name: Clear field choices distinguish exposure browsing from limited comparison
Clicking a real field changes its story, availability and browser history
Technical metadata stays collapsed while clickable provenance opens accessible source panel
Contextual infrared and mask explanations are accessible without opening metadata
Exposure date selection preserves single-exposure meaning and exact export identity
Comparison keeps pending science visible and optional controls closed by default
Both original observations are reachable in the simple source panel
Switching dates and zooming keep linked settings and update journey guidance
Click-to-note makes the question primary while retaining validated sky coordinates
Appearance, wipe and blinking remain available on demand
Actual browser save/reopen restores the question, palette and wipe
Invalid coordinate notes and corrupt comparisons fail without losing a saved question
Existing complete review packet downloads unchanged
Loading hides previous science and disables export until the selected identity is checked
Damaged exposure shows an honest error and supports retry
Reduced-motion keeps manual date switching and disables blinking
